title: Portuguese Flatbread
description: Simple, crispy flatbread originating from Portugal. Paired well with various cheeses and cured meats.
instructions: 1. Mix flour, salt, and dough (if using) in a large bowl.
2. Gradually add water while kneading the dough for 5 minutes.
4. Divide dough into 2-4 portions depending on desired flatbread size.
5. Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
7. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
8. Cook flatbread for 1-2 minutes per side or until golden brown.
9. Let cool on a wire rack.
